description: Surveyed Railways, Highways and Roads is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Lands Branch. This geographic dataset is made up of polygons which depict the surveyed boundaries of Railways, Highways and Roads over Crown land. The shapes are constructed from official survey plans and are maintained in the Crown Land Registry (Tantalis). Attributes include the survey plan number. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Lands Branch. Its tags are Highways, Railways, Roads, surveys. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
